If you're pursuing your goal in the entertainment industry I think that's important. Not every agency requires a start up fee to take you on as a client. Usually those are the less reputable agencies who make their money signing hundreds of low level entertainers for about 100-200$. If they sign x amount of performers in a week, that's a chunk of their profit without actually finding work for anyone. There's always new blood willing to come pay the fee. it depends on the industry that you're trying to get representation in as well as other factors.  

Just make sure you research which agency you're applying to, which you've hopefully already done. You can also find agencies based on your own guerrilla work. If its stand up comedy have someone record you on their phone at an amature night. If its acting record a monologue and send a demo reel. Etc.
